item.title: Lawmakers advance plan to cut Utah income taxes for 6th straight year
item.description: Lawmakers voted 4-1 on Wednesday to advance SB60, which would cut the state’s corporate and income tax rate from 4.5% to 4.45 and could save a typical Utah family around $45 a year.

item.title: Tooele couple recounts hearing loud explosion, escaping flames
item.description: A fire destroyed a Tooele couple's home and took the life of one of their pets Friday night.

item.title: Utah weighs allowing pregnant women to get disabled parking pass
item.description: Rep. Trevor Lee said his bill allowing pregnant women to obtain a temporary disabled parking placard is a way to help them, and perhaps even improve the state's falling fertility rate.

item.title: Eccles Season 2026 – 2027 brings six Broadway new shows to Utah
item.description: The George S. and Dolores Doré Eccles Theater announced its 2026/2027 season on Wednesday, giving KSL an exclusive look at the Broadway touring companies coming to Utah.

item.title: AI cameras now watching for wildfires in southwestern Utah
item.description: Four new high‑tech AI camera stations have been installed as part of a pilot project aimed at detecting smoke from wildfire almost instantly.

item.title: Red Hot Warriors Sprint Past Struggling Utah Jazz
item.description: The Utah Jazz defense allowed Steph Curry and the Golden State Warriors to put on an impressive shooting performance in a 140-124 loss.

item.title: Utah State Suffocates Wyoming In Spectrum Blowout
item.description: The Utah State Aggies put their recent struggles behind them and issued a thorough beating to the Wyoming Cowboys in a 94-62 win.

item.title: Bailey, Sensabaugh Finding Roles, Utah Jazz Fall To Warriors
item.description: The Utah Jazz fell to the Golden State Warriors 140-124 on Wednesday, extending their losing skid to four games.

item.title: New scam targets Utah sellers on any online marketplace with convincing trick
item.description: A new scam is targeting sellers on any online marketplace. Scammers are now posing as Venmo reps to steal your money and your identity.

item.title: Utah bill addresses e-bike safety issues
item.description: A lawmaker introduced a bill Wednesday he hoped would address increasing safety concerns surrounding the use of electric bikes and off-road motorcycles.
